form.documentation:
Send inline form to chat
:param text: Content of inline form. HTML markdown supported
:param markdown: Markdown source rendered by Telegram as a rich message
                 (headings, nested lists, tables, code blocks). Takes
                 precedence over `text`, which may then be left empty
:param rich_html: Rich HTML (`str`) or `Screen` (`inline.screen()`) with
                  in-text buttons, rendered by Telegram. The form falls
                  back to plain text, if Telegram declines it. `text`
                  may be left empty then
:param message: Where to send inline. Can be either `Message` or `int`
:param reply_markup: List of buttons to insert in markup. List of dicts with keys: text, callback
:param force_me: Either this form buttons must be pressed only by owner scope or no
:param always_allow: Users, that are allowed to press buttons in addition to previous rules
:param ttl: Time, when the form is going to be unloaded. Unload means, that the form
            buttons with inline queries and callback queries will become unusable, but
            buttons with type url will still work as usual. Pay attention, that ttl can't
            be bigger, than default one (1 day) and must be either `int` or `False`
:param on_unload: Callback, called when form is unloaded and/or closed. You can clean up trash
                  or perform another needed action
:param manual_security: By default, ataraxia will try to inherit inline buttons security from the caller (command)
                        If you want to avoid this, pass `manual_security=True`
:param disable_security: By default, ataraxia will try to inherit inline buttons security from the caller (command)
                         If you want to disable all security checks on this form in particular, pass `disable_security=True`
:param photo: Attach a photo to the form. URL must be supplied
:param gif: Attach a gif to the form. URL must be supplied
:param file: Attach a file to the form. URL must be supplied
:param mime_type: Only needed, if `file` field is not empty. Must be either 'application/pdf' or 'application/zip'
:param video: Attach a video to the form. URL must be supplied
:param location: Attach a map point to the form. List/tuple must be supplied (latitude, longitude)
                 Example: (55.749931, 48.742371)
                 ⚠️ If you pass this parameter, you'll need to pass empty string to `text` ⚠️
:param audio: Attach a audio to the form. Dict or URL must be supplied
:param silent: Send the form without a notification
:param show_caption_above_media: Bot API 7.4 — render the form text above the
                                 attached photo/gif/video instead of below it
:param top_msg_id: Forum topic to send the form to. Only needed, if `message` is
                   an `int`, since chat id alone carries no topic information.
                   Guessed from `message` automatically otherwise
:param quiet: Don't answer `message` with an error, if the form can't be sent,
              only return `False`, so the caller can fall back on its own
:return: If form is sent, returns :obj:`InlineMessage`, otherwise returns `False`

answer_guest.documentation:
Answer a guest query — post a message into a chat the bot is not in
:param message: Guest message, as received by `bot_guest_watcher`
:param text: Content of the answer. HTML markup supported
:param reply_markup: Buttons to attach, same format as in `form`
:param photo: URL of a photo to attach instead of a plain text message
:param gif: URL of a gif to attach instead of a plain text message
:param video: URL of a video to attach instead of a plain text message
:param title: Title of the result, shown while the message is being sent
:param description: Description of the result
:param ttl: Time in seconds, after which the buttons stop working
:param on_unload: Callback, called when the unit is unloaded
:param force_me: Only the userbot owner may press the buttons
:param always_allow: Users allowed to press the buttons in addition
:param disable_security: Guest chats are public by nature, so buttons are
                         open to everyone, unless `force_me` or
                         `always_allow` is passed
:param show_caption_above_media: Render the caption above the media
:param disable_web_page_preview: Disable link preview in text answers
:return: :obj:`InlineMessage` on success, `False` otherwise

list.documentation:
Send inline list to chat: a form with one of `strings` per page
:param message: Where to send list. Can be either `Message` or `int`
:param strings: List of strings, which should become inline list
:param force_me: Either this list buttons must be pressed only by owner scope or no
:param always_allow: Users, that are allowed to press buttons in addition to previous rules
:param ttl: Time, when the list is going to be unloaded. Unload means, that the list
            will become unusable. Pay attention, that ttl can't
            be bigger, than default one (1 day) and must be either `int` or `False`
:param on_unload: Callback, called when list is unloaded and/or closed. You can clean up trash
                  or perform another needed action
:param manual_security: By default, ataraxia will try to inherit inline buttons security from the caller (command)
                        If you want to avoid this, pass `manual_security=True`
:param disable_security: By default, ataraxia will try to inherit inline buttons security from the caller (command)
                         If you want to disable all security checks on this list in particular, pass `disable_security=True`
:param silent: Send the list without a notification
:param custom_buttons: Custom buttons to add above native ones
:param top_msg_id: Forum topic to send the list to. Only needed, if `message` is
                   an `int`, since chat id alone carries no topic information.
                   Guessed from `message` automatically otherwise
:param markdown: Read `strings` as Markdown sources rendered by Telegram as
                 rich messages (headings, tables, nested lists, code blocks)
                 instead of the default HTML
:param quiet: Don't answer `message` with an error, if the list can't be sent,
              only return `False`
:return: If list is sent, returns :obj:`InlineMessage`, otherwise returns `False`

acceptance.exceptions: New observable differences require an explicit reviewed policy entry; missing implementation is not an accepted exception
acceptance.manifest_check_does_not_prove: Behavioral, security, transport, visual or live Telegram equivalence
acceptance.manifest_check_proves: Pinned source identity, inventory reproducibility and selected Rust structural assertions only

accepted_decisions.decision: Rust core and built-in modules; retain CPython for Python .e and external Python modules through a compatibility bridge
requirements: one Rust owner per Telegram session
real Python syntax and async semantics
accepted_decisions.user_basis: Performance and efficiency are the goal, but Python support should remain

accepted_decisions.decision: Bidirectional versioned session and backup import/export with a lossless compatible profile; never concurrently share a live session or data directory
requirements: preserve portable unknown fields or reject export
unsupported native extensions fail compatibility export explicitly
no sessions or master key in ordinary backups
synthetic roundtrip and separate live acceptance

policy.goal: Current-main Ataraxia user-facing behavior and presentation implemented in Rust

implementation_identity.rule: Rust/Tokio own the core and built-ins; Cargo builds the core, while CPython and a managed Python dependency environment support compatible external code; preserve observable command behavior
Rust repository, commit, transport and layer information must remain truthful; surrounding layout follows upstream
Old web UI is explicit --web opt-in, outside current-main parity; do not delete existing user data

known_deviations_not_accepted_as_parity: Rhai is not Python .e or unmodified Python module compatibility
Security/loader/backup argument and screen parity remains incomplete
Accounts input is target-only rather than upstream's owner-plus-target allow-list
Accounts expired-code Retry asks for phone again; total TTL requires a new .addacc
Widgets and dynamic TL layer parity remain incomplete
Shell requires --allow-shell and updater history policy differs
Rust session and backup formats are distinct
Live Telegram and screenshot parity have not been verified
